_doc: The solid parts of the hulls as boxes: cells of `cell` metres on a grid from `origin` (the mesh's frame, Unreal: x forward, y starboard, z up); a box is [x0, y0, z0, dx, dy, dz] in cells. The places (Keeper Station, the Arsenal...), and the wrecks of the war: the ships' whole hulls and their three pieces (_SecBow, _SecMid, _SecStern). art/blender/space3_solids.py
